requirement.description: The SubprocessCLITransport class is missing the 'read_messages' method that is referenced by several tests. The tests expect a 'read_messages' method but the actual implementation has 'receive_messages'.
requirement.contract: The SubprocessCLITransport class must implement a 'read_messages' method that returns an AsyncIterator[dict[str, Any]] and behaves identically to the existing 'receive_messages' method.

requirement.description: The SubprocessCLITransport class is missing the 'is_ready' method that is referenced by tests.
requirement.contract: The SubprocessCLITransport class must implement an 'is_ready' method that returns a boolean indicating if the transport is connected and ready to communicate.

requirement.description: The ClaudeCodeOptions class is missing the 'env' field that is expected by tests.
requirement.contract: The ClaudeCodeOptions class must include an 'env' field to accept custom environment variables for subprocess execution.

requirement.description: The SubprocessCLITransport.receive_messages method has incorrect async iteration behavior that causes TypeError: 'async for' requires an object with __aiter__ method, got coroutine.
requirement.contract: The SubprocessCLITransport.receive_messages method must properly implement async iteration to allow consumption with 'async for' statements.

requirement.description: The SubprocessCLITransport class is missing the 'end_input' method that is referenced by tests.
requirement.contract: The SubprocessCLITransport class must implement an 'end_input' method to properly signal end of input to the subprocess.
